'''REM-02''', or '''AreeEm-OhToo''' was a hovering [[Droid/Legends|droid]] developed by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] to perform analysis of soil and atmosphere. It was small enough to be carried in a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]], and it was designed to self-protect itself, avoiding dangers while it performed [[Scout/Legends|scout]] duties. It lacked a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] and, while it could analyze the environment, it was not intelligent enough to obtain conclusions or to know what it was that it had seen. As such, REM-02 only sent the results of its survey to an [[enviro-analyzer]]. [[Deeve]], of the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]], carried REM-02 in his backpack to complement the resource remote scan he did on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with the rest of his gear.
